requester_requirement_boundary: The requester requested independent random topic-appropriate test images using the portrait. The mechanical details below were independently authored and are test expectations, not requester locks, user definitions, required semantic facts, or project-derived claims.
concept: The last clamp: a transparent emergency partition holds a pressurized corridor apart from a cryogenic bay torn open to space.
reference_scope: facial appearance and hairstyle only; no actual identity or age inference
evaluation_rule: Inspect saved native pixels directly. Every component and connection of a conjunctive expectation must be visible together. partial or unobservable is not pass. Prompt text, retrieval hits and audit metadata do not establish pixels. No image means no pixel pass.

tests.expected: A clear temporary sheet spans a recognizable rectangular spacecraft hatch. Its entire upper and both side edges attach to clamps, and the lower edge visibly approaches the final corner clamp. The woman occupies the corridor side; a cryogenic bay behind the sheet has an actual torn outer-hull opening showing stars/black space. These near and far sides are joined by the same readable hatch boundary.
tests.fail_if: A window, freestanding screen or decorative clear panel substitutes for a pressure partition, a side/connection is hidden, or the exterior is merely an unrelated backdrop.

tests.expected: Her connected right arm reaches a right hand wrapped around the red over-center lever on the lower-right jamb. Her left palm braces that same rigid jamb above. The unfinished short lower seam just left of the lever remains distinguishable from her gripping hand.
tests.fail_if: The lever floats, contact is absent, a hand belongs to an untraceable arm, the lever is already fully closed, or the gap is hidden by her hand.

tests.expected: The clear sheet bows from the corridor away into the bay. Fine condensation threads visibly cross the unfinished lower gap from her side toward the open bay. The bulge and flow reinforce the same pressure-side relationship.
tests.fail_if: Pressure direction cannot be read, membrane bows toward the woman, condensation is only general fog, or the gap-to-stream connection is missing.

tests.expected: The face remains assessable at output scale and broadly preserves the supplied portrait facial appearance and short dark bob with wispy fringe; compare the actual attached reference directly.
tests.fail_if: Face is too small/occluded for assessment or clearly replaces the reference with a different generic appearance. A visual resemblance is not proof of real identity.

tests.expected: One knee rests on corridor floor, the opposite boot is planted, torso and both shoulders/arms form a plausible crouching chain beside the low clamp, and both arms stay on the corridor side of the membrane.
tests.fail_if: Support is absent or hidden at consequential scale, limbs merge or cross through the sheet, or the working clamp lies beyond plausible reach.

tests.expected: Without reading the prompt, the image suggests an active attempt to preserve a habitable spacecraft space against a nearby vacuum breach; the hand, fragile boundary, escaping material and distant void direct attention to the same immediate danger.
tests.fail_if: The scene reads only as a posed astronaut portrait or attractive science-fiction corridor with disconnected machinery.
